castle.concept: Northeast castle enclave for the bounded riverside city: a walled court with a gated wall, four hollow square corner towers with stepped roof silhouettes (no internal stairs or walkable tower platforms), and a keep that is a two-floor detailed stone building with gable roof. The gate and courtyard approach are deterministic derivations of the set dimensions.

home_a.concept: Alder Bank Cottage: a compact single-storey riverside home of warm stone walls on a low plinth, framed windows and a columned porch, capped by a wood gable roof with a loft store reached by a continuous stair. The ground floor holds a hearth room and a bed room.

home_b.concept: Bramble Two-Storey House: plastered two-floor family residence near a plaza, with bed and kitchen on the ground floor, hearth and store above, a slate spire roof, framed windows, porch columns, and a continuous stair linking both levels.

home_c.concept: Cobble Court Spire House: a two-storey stone residence with a stair turret and slate spire roof, matching the home_c archetype. Ground floor holds a counter room and hearth room; upper floor holds two bed rooms. Framed windows, porch columns, continuous interior stairs and furnished rooms are built by the detailed constructor.

home_d.concept: Dunlin Flat-Roof Lodge: a single-storey riverside residence with plastered walls, framed windows, porch columns, and a continuous stair to a flat parapeted wood roof used for storage. The ground floor has a hearth room and a bed room.

shop_a.concept: Anvil and Apron Smithy: a two-floor stone shop facing the street, with the forge counter and market stall on the ground floor and a timber-framed store plus kitchen above. Framed windows, porch columns, continuous stairs and detailed interiors are built by the established constructor; the wood gable roof gives a compact workshop silhouette in the row.

shop_b.concept: Bellhaven Provisioners: a two-floor plaster shop on a riverside plaza, with counter and store on the ground floor and kitchen and bed above. Framed windows, porch columns, continuous stair, slate gable roof, and detailed interior fixtures are constructed by the established recipe so each D-assigned shop_b footprint is fully enterable and furnished.

shop_c.concept: Copper Kettle Market Hall: a two-storey stone shop with a slate spire roof, built with framed windows and porch columns. The ground floor holds the market stall and counter; the upper floor contains the kitchen and store, reached by a continuous internal stair.

shop_d.concept: Two-floor plaster inn, Drovers Rest Flat-Roof Inn: hearth and counter rooms on the ground floor with framed windows, porch columns and continuous stair; bed and kitchen rooms above. Flat wood roof with roof store access, stone plinth and chimney providing material contrast within the city set.
